title: Late Heavy Bombardment
summary: A hypothesised surge of asteroid impacts on the inner solar system, inferred from Apollo moon-rock impact melts that cluster near 3.9 billion years old. It was thought to follow a shift in giant-planet orbits. Whether it was a true spike or only the tail of earlier impacts is still debated.

uncertainty.note: Interval as given by the University of Hawai'i PSRD article; NASA says only around 4 billion years ago with a duration of 20 to 200 million years. Existence of the spike is itself disputed.

importance.justification: Long-debated hypothesis about the impact history of the Moon and the inner planets, relevant to early Earth.
